title: Sécurité
description: Security posture of this computer: a security score (100 minus weighted findings); antivirus (Windows Security Center products, Microsoft Defender real-time protection, signature age, last scan, recent threats; ClamAV on Linux); firewall (Windows profiles and inbound allow rules; firewalld or ufw zones and open services / ports on Linux); disk encryption per volume (BitLocker state and protector types, LUKS; never any key); platform protections (Secure Boot, VBS / HVCI / Credential Guard, LSA protection, UAC, SmartScreen, PowerShell execution policy; SELinux / AppArmor and kernel lockdown on Linux); local accounts (enabled, administrator, last logon, password settings) and privileged groups; open sessions and failed logons over 24 hours; password and lockout policy; remote access (RDP and NLA, WinRM, SSH server settings); obsolete protocols on Windows (SMBv1, TLS 1.0 / 1.1, NTLMv1); suspicious persistence entries; locally added root certificates. Findings flag every weakness with a recommendation.

functions.name: get_logons
functions.title: Connexions et échecs
functions.help: Ouvertures de session réussies et échouées sur la période : compte, origine, type de connexion. Beaucoup d'échecs peuvent signaler une tentative d'intrusion. Sous Windows, demande les droits administrateur.
functions.description: Successful and failed logons of this computer over a time window: time, account, kind (local, remote desktop, SSH, unlock, sudo…), source address and result, newest first, plus failures grouped by account and source address. Windows reads the Security log (needs SysInfo to run as administrator); Linux reads wtmp (last) and the journal (sshd, PAM, sudo failures).

parameters.name: sinceHours
parameters.label: Depuis (heures)
parameters.description: Time window, in hours before now.

parameters.name: result
parameters.label: Résultat
parameters.description: Keep successful logons, failed logons or both.

parameters.name: top
parameters.label: Connexions affichées (max.)
parameters.description: Maximum number of logons returned.

functions.name: get_firewall_rules
functions.title: Règles du pare-feu
functions.help: Règles du pare-feu, filtrées par sens (entrant/sortant), action et texte. Les règles trop larges (ouvertes à tout le monde, tous ports) sont signalées.
functions.description: Firewall rules of this computer. Windows: enabled rules with direction, action, profiles, protocol, local ports, remote addresses and program, flagging broad inbound allow rules (any port, any address, public profile, program outside system folders). Linux: firewalld zones (interfaces, services, ports, rich rules) or ufw status.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.label: Sens
parameters.description: Windows: inbound, outbound or all. Ignored on Linux (firewalld zones describe inbound traffic).

parameters.name: action
parameters.label: Action
parameters.description: Windows: keep allow rules, block rules or both. Ignored on Linux.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.label: Texte
parameters.description: Keep only rules whose name, program, service or port contains this text (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: top
parameters.label: Règles affichées (max.)
parameters.description: Maximum number of rules returned.

functions.name: find_persistence
functions.title: Points de persistance
functions.help: Liste tout ce qui se lance automatiquement (démarrage, services, tâches, extensions…) et signale ce qui est suspect. Cocher « Suspects seulement » pour ne garder que les éléments douteux.
functions.description: Every place a program can start itself automatically, with the command and why it looks suspicious (temporary or public folder, encoded or downloading script, unsigned binary, missing file, hijacked logon or debugger key, WMI consumer, preloaded library). Windows: Run / RunOnce keys, startup folders, Winlogon, Image File Execution Options debuggers, AppInit_DLLs, non-Microsoft scheduled tasks, WMI event subscriptions. Linux: cron (system and own crontab), local systemd units (system and user), autostart desktop entries, rc.local, ld.so.preload.

parameters.name: suspiciousOnly
parameters.label: Suspects seulement
parameters.description: Return only the entries flagged as suspicious.

parameters.name: includeVendor
parameters.label: Inclure Microsoft / paquets
parameters.description: Also return entries from Microsoft (Windows scheduled tasks under \Microsoft) or installed by a distribution package (Linux).

functions.name: get_certificates
functions.title: Certificats
functions.help: Certificats installés (personnels, racines de confiance…) avec leur date d'expiration ; ceux qui expirent bientôt ou les autorités racines ajoutées sont signalés.
functions.description: Certificates of this computer: subject, issuer, store, expiry date and days left, flagging expired or soon-expiring certificates and root certificates added locally (not shipped by Windows Update or the distribution), which can reveal TLS interception. Windows: LocalMachine and CurrentUser stores; Linux: system CA bundle and local trust anchors. Thumbprints and keys are never returned.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.label: Magasins
parameters.description: personal = machine and user personal certificates (with a private key usage), roots = trusted roots and intermediate authorities, added = locally added roots only, all = everything.

parameters.name: expiringDays
parameters.label: Expire sous (jours)
parameters.description: Flag certificates expiring within this many days.

parameters.name: top
parameters.label: Certificats affichés (max.)
parameters.description: Maximum number of certificates returned.

functions.name: get_acl
functions.title: Autorisations d'un dossier
functions.help: Montre qui a le droit de lire ou modifier un dossier ou un fichier, et signale les autorisations trop ouvertes (modifiable par tout le monde).
functions.description: Permissions of one file or folder: owner and access rules (identity, rights, allow / deny, inherited) on Windows; owner, group, mode and ACL entries (getfacl) on Linux. Flags write access granted to everyone or to all users. Only metadata is read, never the content.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Chemin
parameters.description: Full path of the file or folder.

functions.name: find_special_files
functions.title: Fichiers SUID et modifiables par tous
functions.help: Linux : cherche les programmes à privilèges (SUID/SGID) et les fichiers modifiables par tous, en signalant ceux qui n'appartiennent à aucun paquet. Tâche longue sur un dossier large.
functions.description: Searches a file system tree for SUID / SGID executables (run with their owner's rights) or world-writable files and folders, and tells which ones are not owned by an installed package (unusual, worth checking). Stays on one file system; can take several seconds on a large tree.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.label: Type
parameters.description: suid = SUID and SGID executables; writable = world-writable files and folders without the sticky bit.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Dossier
parameters.description: Root of the search (stays on its file system).

parameters.name: top
parameters.label: Fichiers affichés (max.)
parameters.description: Maximum number of files returned.

functions.name: start_scan
functions.title: Analyse antivirus rapide
functions.help: Lance une analyse antivirus rapide (Microsoft Defender sous Windows, ClamAV sous Linux). Tâche longue ; les menaces trouvées apparaissent dans les constats.
functions.description: Runs a quick antivirus scan of this computer and returns the threats found. Windows: Microsoft Defender quick scan (memory, startup and usual locations), then the threats detected since it started; blocked when another antivirus is active. Linux: ClamAV (clamdscan when the daemon runs, else clamscan) on Downloads, Desktop, ~/.local/bin, autostart, /tmp, /var/tmp and /dev/shm; nothing is deleted. Takes a few minutes. Blocked when no supported antivirus is installed.

functions.name: update_signatures
functions.title: Mettre à jour les signatures
functions.help: Met à jour les définitions de virus de l'antivirus. Nécessite Internet.
functions.description: Updates the antivirus signatures now. Windows: Update-MpSignature (Microsoft Defender). Linux: freshclam (needs root; blocked when the clamav-freshclam service already updates them). Returns the signature version or date before and after.

functions.name: set_firewall
functions.title: Modifier le pare-feu
functions.help: Modifie le pare-feu : l'activer, le désactiver, ouvrir ou fermer un port. Action critique : droits administrateur ; désactiver le pare-feu expose la machine.
functions.description: Changes the firewall. enable / disable: Windows profiles (Set-NetFirewallProfile), ufw, or the firewalld service. allow_port: opens an inbound port (Windows: a rule in the SysInfo group; firewalld: permanent port in the default zone; ufw allow). block_port: Windows blocking rule; Linux: removes the open port (ufw deny). remove_rule: Windows: deletes a rule of the SysInfo group only (ruleName); Linux: removes the port. Blocked when nothing would change (port already open by a range…) and for hand-written nftables rulesets. Reversible.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.label: Opération
parameters.description: enable, disable, allow_port, block_port or remove_rule.

parameters.name: port
parameters.label: Port
parameters.description: Port for allow_port, block_port and remove_rule on Linux.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.label: Protocole
parameters.description: tcp or udp.

parameters.name: firewallProfile
parameters.label: Profil (Windows)
parameters.description: Windows profile: all, domain, private or public. Ignored on Linux.

parameters.name: ruleName
parameters.label: Règle (Windows)
parameters.description: Windows: display name of a SysInfo rule to remove.
